title: [Request] Sambanova.ai using preview.snova.ai endpoint for 671B R1 model
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

As I got the email from Sambanova.ai, that the `DeepSeek-R1` using the `https://preview.snova.ai/v1/chat/completions` endpoint, different from  another models.
Here is the email content:


CORE INFO: DeepSeek-R1 671B API Access Confirmation

API ENDPOINT: https://preview.snova.ai/v1/chat/completions

CURL COMMAND:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
    "stream": true,
    "model": "DeepSeek-R1",
    "messages": [
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": "Hello"
        }
    ]
}' \
-X POST https://preview.snova.ai/v1/chat/completions
```

LIMITATIONS:
- Rate limit: 10 requests/minute
- Daily limit: 2000 requests
- Sequence length: 4K
- Only available on [preview.snova.ai](https://preview.snova.ai/) (not [api.sambanova.ai](https://api.sambanova.ai/))


### 🧐 Proposed Solution

If request the `DeepSeek-R1`, change the endpoint to `preview.snova.ai`

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
